notes: The ASV's will not hearken renders the verb of willing plus the infinitive, so will goes to 'abah and hearken to the infinitive, with the intervening lamed unrepresented in both clauses (rules 40, 52).
The existential 'eyn heads on not and its suffix takes the referential they, no dummy there being written (rule 50).
The resumptive hemmah (s027) is unrepresented beside the explicit subject all the house of Israel (rule 22).
